title: Four Got On. FIVE Got Off 🍦
description:
Four of us got on the Ferris wheel. Five got off. You get one turn of the wheel to find the extra one.

Find the extra one, #2. A new place and a new crew, same job: one of these riders never got on.

It's made up. A blocky puzzle, built with code and Blender.
pin: Which rider was the extra, A to E? What gave it away first for you, the cone or the shadow?
